CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
